reason: I have one apartment next to my house and the laminated sheet plus Booking messages already tell guests the Wi-Fi and the rules. If they need anything else they knock on my door, and I like that. On $10,000 a year, €150 plus €35 a month is money I don't have for something I don't need.
objection: My guests like talking to me personally, not to a robot. With one unit I'm right there, so a machine answering for me feels cold and it's an expense I can't justify.
